identity.name: Levante
identity.tagline: Small plates. Big table. Every time.
identity.one_line_description: Levante is a Mediterranean mezze bar offering a curated, shareable dining experience rooted in the flavors of the eastern Mediterranean.
identity.target_audience: Urban food-forward diners aged 28–50 who value quality ingredients, communal dining, and a refined yet relaxed atmosphere for both weeknight meals and special occasions.

pages.title: Home
pages.goal: Immediately communicate Levante's identity as a refined Mediterranean mezze bar, establish appetite appeal, and drive visitors toward the menu and reservations.
pages.meta_description: Levante is a Mediterranean mezze bar serving shareable small plates inspired by the flavors of the eastern Mediterranean. Explore our menu and reserve your table.

sections.intent: Make a strong first impression that captures the communal, abundant spirit of mezze dining and prompts visitors to explore the menu or book a table.
sections.headline: Every Meal Deserves a Longer Table
sections.subheadline: Shareable plates, bold flavors, and a dining ritual worth repeating — welcome to Levante.

asset_ideas.subject: A minimal top-down arrangement of mezze plates — hummus, olives, flatbread, and small bowls — laid out on a shared table surface.
asset_ideas.purpose: Creates immediate visual appetite appeal and communicates the communal mezze concept without requiring photography.

sections.intent: Highlight the three core pillars of the Levante experience so visitors immediately understand what makes this restaurant distinct.
sections.headline: A Different Kind of Dinner
sections.subheadline: Three principles guide everything we put on the table.

items.title: Seasonal & Sourced
items.description: Our mezze changes with the season. We work with regional suppliers to bring the freshest ingredients from farm and sea to your table.

items.title: Built for Sharing
items.description: Every plate is designed to be passed, tasted, and discussed. The more people at the table, the better the meal.

items.title: Rooted in Tradition
items.description: Our recipes draw from Lebanese, Turkish, Greek, and Israeli culinary traditions — interpreted with care and precision.

sections.intent: Give visitors a brief, emotionally resonant glimpse into the origin of Levante to build trust and personal connection before they commit to a visit.
sections.headline: Born from a Table in Beirut
sections.subheadline: Levante began as a memory — a long afternoon, a crowded table, and fifteen plates that never seemed to run out.
sections.body: Our founders carried that experience back across the Mediterranean and spent two years perfecting the menu you'll find here today. Levante isn't just a restaurant. It's a format for gathering.

sections.intent: Convert engaged homepage visitors into reservations or menu explorers with a clear, confident close.
sections.headline: Your Table Is Waiting
sections.subheadline: Walk-ins welcome. Reservations recommended on weekends.

sections.intent: Orient the visitor to the menu page and set the tone for the culinary experience they are about to explore.

pages.title: Our Story
pages.goal: Build an emotional and cultural connection between Levante and the visitor by telling the founders' story, articulating the restaurant's philosophy, and establishing long-term brand trust.
pages.meta_description: Learn the story behind Levante — a Mediterranean mezze bar born from a passion for communal dining, seasonal ingredients, and the culinary traditions of the eastern Mediterranean.

sections.intent: Introduce the story section and prime the visitor for a narrative journey rather than a transactional page.
sections.headline: We Set the Table. You Make the Memory.
sections.subheadline: Levante was built on the belief that the best meals are never eaten alone.

sections.intent: Tell the founding story with enough personal detail to create genuine emotional resonance and differentiate Levante from generic restaurant brands.
sections.headline: An Afternoon That Refused to End
sections.body: In 2019, co-founders Nadia Khalil and Marco Esposito sat down for what was supposed to be a quick lunch at a family-run mezze house in Beirut's Gemmayzeh neighborhood. Four hours later, they were still at the table. The food had long since been cleared, but the conversation — and the feeling — refused to leave. They came home with notebooks full of recipes, supplier contacts, and a single shared conviction: that the mezze format, done right, could change how people eat together in any city in the world. Levante opened its first location in 2021.

asset_ideas.subject: A simple, clean line-art map of the eastern Mediterranean coastline — Lebanon, Turkey, Greece, Israel — with subtle dots marking cities of culinary influence.
asset_ideas.purpose: Visually anchors the story in a specific geography and reinforces the brand's authentic regional roots.

sections.intent: Articulate the core values and philosophy that guide every decision at Levante, from sourcing to service.
sections.headline: How We Think About Food
sections.subheadline: Four commitments that shape everything from the supplier relationships to the plate presentation.

items.title: Provenance First
items.description: We know the name of every farm, fishery, and creamery we work with. If we can't trace it, we don't serve it.

items.title: Seasonal Without Exception
items.description: The menu shifts quarterly. Some favorites return. Others make way for what the season demands.

items.title: Hospitality as Practice
items.description: In the eastern Mediterranean, hospitality is not a service standard — it is a cultural obligation. We hold that standard.

items.title: The Long Lunch Principle
items.description: We design the experience so that no one feels rushed. The table is yours for the evening.

sections.intent: Convert visitors who have just read the story into action — either exploring the menu or booking a table.
sections.headline: The Table Has Always Been Set for You
sections.subheadline: Come hungry. Come with people you like. Stay as long as you want.

sections.intent: Pre-emptively answer the most common visitor questions to reduce inbound enquiries and build confidence before a visit.
sections.headline: Questions We Hear Often

items.title: Do you cater to dietary requirements?
items.description: Yes. Our menu is clearly labeled for vegan (VG), vegetarian (V), and gluten-free (GF) options. Please inform your server of any allergies when you arrive.

items.title: How does mezze ordering work?
items.description: We recommend 3–4 plates per person as a guide, but there are no rules. Order as you go — our kitchen sends plates as they're ready.

items.title: Is there a minimum spend for private events?
items.description: Yes. Private dining room bookings have a minimum food spend of £600. Full venue buyouts are quoted on request.

items.title: Do you take walk-ins?
items.description: Always, subject to availability. For groups of 6 or more, we strongly recommend a reservation.

sections.intent: Provide a final, warm close that reinforces the brand's hospitality ethos and confirms the visitor's decision to visit or reach out.
